title: Invertibility of the canonical internal Hom comparison for translation
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a small site, $s:C\simeq C$ have continuous inverse, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, $a:(s^{-1})^*R\simeq R$, $P$ a RestrictionPresentation [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data] and $T$ TensorComparisons [lem-sf-twisted-action-tensor-comparisons]. Let $F=\sigma$ and $b_{M,Q}:F(M\otimes Q)\simeq FM\otimes FQ$ be T.sigmaTensor. For any base-site module sheaves $M,N$, put $H=\mathcal Hom_R(M,N)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. Then the explicit map $\gamma_{M,N}=\operatorname{curry}(b_{M,H}^{-1}F(\mathrm{ev}_{M,N})):FH\to\mathcal Hom_R(FM,FN)$ is invertible, where evaluation and currying are those of the ordinary sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

source.place: lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor; formal internal-Hom preservation for the tensor autoequivalence sigma, written by D4.

proof.text: Transpose the inverse translation tensor comparison followed by translated evaluation. For test objects FQ, postcomposition with the transpose equals the composite of full faithfulness of F, the tensor-Hom adjunction, the tensor isomorphism, and the adjunction in the target; tensor naturality proves the equality. These maps are bijective. Essential surjectivity of the translation equivalence and the Yoneda criterion prove that the transpose is invertible.

proof_origin.place: lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor; formal internal-Hom preservation for the tensor autoequivalence sigma, written by D4.

mathlib_searches.query: Currying in a monoidal closed category commutes with an invertible action of a tensor autoequivalence, with conjugate action on internal Hom
mathlib_searches.results: MonoidalClosed.curry, curryHomEquiv, ofEquiv_curry_def and functor-category Hom equivalences. These provide ordinary adjunction operations but not the displayed fixed-pair equation for the normalized tensor data.

mathlib_searches.query: forgetful functor from equivariant objects of monoidal autoequivalence preserves internal Hom
mathlib_searches.results: Action forgetful monoidal comparisons, Rep.ihom and functor-category closed structures. None has the twisted sigma action and the TensorComparisons interface.

No existing node states this fixed-pair currying criterion. The parent TwistedActionHomEvaluationComparisons has a private translation-isomorphism proof, and TwistedActionClosedComparisons has private evaluation identities. Their proof methods are reused without importing these consumers. Mathlib Groupoid closed functor categories require a different untwisted functor-category presentation.

from.place: The parent obligation has no created.item blueprint ancestor. Its recorded provenance is lem-a1-local-boundary-duality and the evaluation/biduality sentence of thm-coef-qbar-verdier. This site realization supplies the abelian-category foundation for the internal-Hom and evaluation argument of cor-coef-verdier-weil-equivariance, without replacing the native derived category by fixed pairs in a derived category. Original twisted-site proof steps 9--13; sheafification and localized-site Hom calculation. Substep: Original closed-comparisons proof steps 3--4 and evaluation portion of step 5 (original action-site steps 11--13); sites-modules.tex, section-internal-hom, lemma-internal-hom-restriction and lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor. Restriction-only substep: invertibility of the transpose of restricted evaluation; translation preservation and both evaluation equations are proved in the parent.

theorem isIso_translationHomComparison (P : RestrictionPresentation J s R a)
    (T : TensorComparisons J s R a P) (M N : Modules R) :
    IsIso (SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv (R := R) _ _ _
      ((T.sigmaTensor M (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) M N)).inv ≫
        (sigma J s R a).map (evaluationMap M N)))
